known_limitations: No GitHub OAuth, fine-grained read-only token entered manually in viewer
Token not stored across refresh, credentials never sent to preview iframe
Nested circular/dynamic ESM imports and import.meta.url-relative assets unsupported
Relative file requests must remain under selected HTML directory
External private raw GitHub URLs will not be authenticated
Pages shows public viewer code but not private project contents
Source JS inside the sandbox may make network requests; open trusted works only
releasePolicy: Isolated viewer path only; do not change other Pages products, migration, canon or skills
